name: e3d-brain
description: Local-first memory over a plain-Markdown vault: cited search, a review inbox, and proposals a human accepts.
long_description: e3d-brain gives Claude cited search over a folder of Markdown notes (an Obsidian vault) and a review inbox for proposed notes. Nothing becomes permanent memory until you accept it, and every change can be undone. Runs entirely on this computer; nothing is sent anywhere.

vault_dir.title: Vault folder
vault_dir.description: The folder of Markdown notes (an Obsidian vault) to use as memory.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: inbox: Claude can search and propose notes into a review inbox. read-only: Claude can only search and read.
